source: so the project that will be selled will be the ../CyberAlchemy-lab that is the consolidated and fixed version of cyberALchemy-v2, ARE will be another project selled separatedly, Craft + Alch will be selled too. and we are going to sell the service of a person sending a alch file and we are going to host it like a serverless service

offerings.name: CyberAlchemy Lab
offerings.positioning: Owner-selected consolidated and corrected successor to cyberAlchemy-v2, located at ../CyberAlchemy-lab.
offerings.customer_outcome: Obtain access/co-ownership to the selected Lab project version under its stated terms.
offerings.boundary: Selling the successor does not sell the entire cyberAlchemy-v2 evidence tree. The inspected initial README is not proof of a completed stable release.

offerings.name: Agent Reasoning Engine (ARE)
offerings.positioning: Separate project offering for governed reasoning and context continuity.
offerings.customer_outcome: Obtain ARE independently of Lab, choosing Static without the improvements engine or Full with it.
offerings.boundary: One ARE product with two commercial editions. Exact edition components and dependencies remain to be defined. Static does not by itself decide memory, context-state, maintenance updates or support entitlements.

editions.name: ARE Static
editions.description: ARE offered without the improvements engine.

editions.name: ARE Full
editions.description: ARE offered with the improvements engine.

consolidation.decision: Consolidate dispersed ARE directories into one coherent product later
consolidation.boundary: Two commercial editions of one product; no current directory merge, runtime cutover or release implied.

offerings.name: Craft + Alch
offerings.positioning: Combined commercial offering for the Craft product and Alch authoring capability.
offerings.customer_outcome: Obtain the selected tools/version to author and construct services with Alch and Craft.
offerings.boundary: Combined offering follows the user’s Craft + Alch wording; contents and entitlements remain to be specified. Craft retains the DomainSpec v2 product lineage.

offerings.name: Managed Alch hosting
offerings.positioning: Customer submits an Alch file; Exchange hosts its supported behavior as a callable serverless service.
offerings.customer_outcome: Run the authored service without operating the underlying server themselves.
offerings.boundary: A service purchase is distinct from acquiring a project. Elastic scaling, scale-to-zero, arbitrary-code execution, billing units and availability guarantees are not implied by existing local prototypes.

offerings.name: Community local inference
offerings.positioning: Community members make their locally running models available to other callers.
offerings.customer_outcome: Invoke an offered model without setting up the provider’s model on the caller’s machine.
offerings.boundary: Provider operates the engine; Exchange hosts the submitted Alch service in EX-O04. These can compose but are distinct offerings.
